rationale: The agent proceeded to modify the pending order and process a refund without first confirming the change with the user, violating the explicit policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. While it appears to have attempted authentication and acted on the user’s orders, the lack of confirmation alone fails the pass bar. Additionally, the agent did not demonstrate that the selected replacement is the highest-resolution waterproof option within the previous price, which raises doubt about correctness of the requested change.
